'''Beezar Pert''' was the famous [[Gungan/Legends|Gungan]] [[Band/Legends|bandleader]] of the [[Great Municipal Band/Legends|Great Municipal Band]] and the [[Musician/Legends|composer]] of the "[[Symponika Crunchen-Grand]]," a historical work of [[Music/Legends|music]] known as a [[symponik]], which recounted the formation of the [[Gungan Grand Army/Legends|Gungan Grand Army]]. Beezar lived to an old age in the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Otoh Gunga/Legends|Otoh Gunga]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]]. Before<ref name="DB" /> his<ref name="CSWE" /> retirement as leader of the band<ref name="DB" /> sometime prior to the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]],<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> he took on the task of training young [[musikagung]] prodigy [[Augara Jowil/Legends|Augara Jowil]], who eventually replaced him as bandleader.<ref name="DB" />

During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the rebelling [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]], Pert was coaxed out of retirement by several other prominent Naboo musicians for a special concert in the [[Palace Plaza/Legends|Palace Plaza]] of [[Theed/Legends|Theed]],<ref name="blog">{{SW|url=news/slugthrowers-an-overview-of-popular-music-and-musicians-in-a-galaxy-far-far-away-part-1|series=Slugthrowers: An Overview of Popular Music and Musicians in a Galaxy Far, Far Away|text=Part 1|nolive=1}}</ref> the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] city of Naboo,<ref name="TPM">{{Film|I}}</ref> to honor the orphans of both Republic and Separatist forces.<ref name="blog" />

==Behind the scenes==
Beezar Pert was first mentioned in the [[StarWars.com]] [[Databank (original)|Databank]] entry "Augara 'Augie' Jowil," which was written by [[Hyperspace: The Official Star Wars Fan Club|Hyperspace]] member [[Chad Finke]] and published through the website's "[[What's The Story?]]" feature<ref name="DB" /> on [[January 12]], [[2007]].<ref name="jan12">{{SWArchive|url=databank/updates/news20070112.html|text=What's the Story: Episode I}}</ref>
